IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:

Winds: Westerly 15 to 20 knots tending southwesterly in the middle of the day then shifting northerly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 25 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then turning west to southwesterly in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 26 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the day then becoming variable below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 27 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the day then turning northeasterly during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny. 50% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: In the wake of a trough which crossed Tasmania overnight, a cold southwesterly airstream is forecast persist this morning. A high will pass to the north of Tasmania later tonight and move to the east of the state by early Wednesday, where it is expected to slowly move east during Thursday and Friday while maintaining a weak ridge over Tasmania.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Tuesday 24 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the morning. Winds decreasing to 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: 2 to 3 metres, decreasing to 1.5 to 2 metres around midday.
Swell: West to southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore early this morning. Possible small hail during the morning and afternoon.

Wednesday 25 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending north to northwesterly before dawn then tending southeast to southwesterly in the late evening. Winds reaching up to 20 knots offshore during the morning.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 26 November

Seas: Below 1 metre.

Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
